name: KJ Verse [JK UPD]
desc:
KJV or KJ Verse

KJ Verse is A battleground Game Inspired By yielding Arts and on KJ Series

🖥️ PC Controls
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - punch
Shiftlock - Leftshift

Join our group for updates and sneak peeks

Thank you to everyone who is involved in the development of KJ Verse
